chunks: Have you not considered those who were hypocritical?

They say to their brethren among the People of the Book who disbelieve: 'If you are driven out, we shall certainly go out with you, and we shall never obey anyone against you forever; and if you are fought, we shall certainly help you.'
And God bears witness that they are indeed liars.

key_terms.أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ: People of the Book (Jews and Christians)
key_terms.نَافَقُوا: They were hypocritical (showed outward faith but hid disbelief)

ai.seo_question: What did the hypocrites promise the People of the Book, and what did God say about their sincerity?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the strategic alliance between the hypocrites of Medina and the Jewish tribes, specifically the Banu Nadir, during the period of their expulsion. Shia exegetes emphasize that their pledge was not rooted in genuine faith but in political opportunism, as they sought to leverage the People of the Book against the Muslims while remaining insulated from the consequences. The divine testimony of their falsehood underscores the fragility of political alliances devoid of sincere commitment to the cause.
